levels.surface: عمرو بن عبد الله بن صفوان

shared_tail.surface: عمرو بن عبد الله بن صفوان

notes: «ح» splits the routes; the names after the second branch's «قال أخبرني» are written once for both: the shared tail (rule 3)

The three remarks by Abu Dawud and by the narrator Amr about another transmitter (ابن صفوان; أمية بن صفوان; عمرو بن عبد الله بن صفوان and كلدة بن الحنبل under Yahya) name different transmitters for the same saying: variant groups, not routes (rule 4)
The head of the remark «قال عمرو وأخبرني ابن صفوان» (Amr) is not written as a separate link: the surface is too often repeated to pin it safely
Companion-level last link is كلدة بن حنبل: the saying relays his story of Safwan's gift (rule 6)
